title: Mirvetuximab soravtansine Therapy

page_map.1: FRα-positive platinum-resistant high-grade serous disease following 1–3 systemic regimens. Dose, infusion escalation, diluent and visit schedule.
page_map.2: AIBW formula, ≥75% cutoff at 2+/3+ membrane staining, ECOG 0–2, cautions and exclusions.
page_map.3: Baseline and repeat monitoring. Eye evaluation and prescriber review for new or worsening symptoms.
page_map.4: AIBW reductions; renal, hepatic, corneal, lung and neuropathy pathways.
page_map.5: Infusion reactions, haematological and other toxicities; moderate emetic risk.
page_map.6: Premedications, lubricants and ophthalmology-directed secondary topical steroid prevention.

clinical_review_status: pending independent consultant and oncology-pharmacy validation
